units.source_text: 我有点踌躇，要不要走到母亲的跟前。

en.t: I hesitated a little, wondering whether I should go up to my mother.

units.source_text: 我也有点纳闷，为什么母亲会到这里来。

en.t: I was also somewhat puzzled as to why my mother had come here.

units.source_text: 后来我才明白老师知道我出走后，就到母亲那里打听，

en.t: Only later did I understand that after my teacher learned I had run away, he went to ask my mother about it,

units.source_text: 母亲惊慌失措地赶到鹿苑寺，就这样住了下来。

en.t: and my mother, in a panic, rushed to Rokuonji and ended up staying there.
